summary:
The model node is done: `due` is supported in `src/model/`, and all 106 tests pass. The rest of the `--due` chain (add flag, list display, CLI parsing) is not done, because it sits outside this node's fence.

**What changed in `src/model/todo.ts`:**
- `Todo` has an optional `due?: string` (YYYY-MM-DD). It is only present on the object when set, so existing data and callers are unaffected.
- `addTodo(state, title, due?)` takes the optional due date. Numbering is unchanged.
